$comment: AI-ROADMAP Phase 2 — known-failing AI tests. Generated by `npm run test:ai-known-failures:update`. Entries may only be REMOVED (by fixing the test); adding one is a deliberate act that needs a reason and a ticket.

reasons.assertion_mismatch: The code and the test disagree about expected behaviour. Each needs a product decision (is the test stale, or did the behaviour regress?) — not a mechanical fix. Triage per e2e-bug.351.
reasons.mock_shape_undefined: Spec constructs a service with an incomplete mock; a collaborator the code calls is undefined. Mechanical to fix — extend the mock. Not a product bug.
reasons.mock_missing_transaction: Spec's repository/manager mock has no `transaction`, so any code path opening one throws. Same class as mock_shape_undefined and the largest single cluster (7 suites, 48 tests) — likely one shared test helper fixes all of them.
